summary.zh: 本次更新重新设计了 OAuth 登录：授权交换改走自托管后端，App 密钥不再保存在手机上，并加入回调防伪校验。
summary.en: This update redesigns OAuth sign-in: the token exchange now runs through a self-hosted backend so the app secret never touches the device, with callback forgery protection added.

items.zh: 修复从浏览器授权后跳回应用时登录不生效的问题
items.en: Fixed OAuth login not completing when returning from the browser

items.zh: OAuth 登录开箱即用：无需再自己创建 OAuth 应用，授权页自动配置
items.en: OAuth sign-in works out of the box — no manual OAuth app setup required

items.zh: 授权回调加入一次性 state 校验，伪造回调无法换取令牌
items.en: One-time state verification on the OAuth callback blocks forged callbacks

items.zh: 自定义 OAuth 客户端仍然可用：填写后自动切换为设备直连交换
items.en: Custom OAuth clients still work — setting one switches to direct on-device exchange

items.zh: 设置页可查看和修改 OAuth 后端地址，清除后自动恢复默认
items.en: OAuth backend URL is now visible and editable in settings; clearing restores the default
